title: "SMN hands-on workshop in Uppsala"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

A hands-on tutorial for the [first in-person Swedish Metabarcoding Network (SMN) meeting](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"}: Wednesday 9 December 2026, 09:00–12:00, Evolutionary Biology Centre (EBC), Uppsala.

You will download eDNA/metabarcoding data published through the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"} from the ASV portal and explore them in R, in one of two tracks: insects or marine plankton.

[Start the tutorial →](tutorial.qmd)

## Instructors
- Dr. Tobias Andermann — SBDI & Uppsala University
- Prof. Anders Andersson — SBDI & KTH SciLifeLab
- Dr. Daniel Lundin — SBDI & Linnaeus University
- Dr. Maria Prager — SBDI & University of Gothenburg
